item.title: ForenSynth AI v2.4: evidence first, analyst reviewed
item.description: ForenSynth AI v2.4 moves the project toward an evidence model that an analyst can inspect. The beta implementation is being prepared for review. It is not a claim of validated production readiness. What changed Evidence preservation: original detection export bytes, SHA-256 artifact hashes, and a run manifest. Normalized records: individual and aggregate Chainsaw detections, unique events, rule matches, hosts, users, and process fields. Visible coverage: full parsed evidence stays in exports; selected, omitted, rejected, and AI-skipped records are recorded separately.
